componentSets.description: Recording stops capture, never the task. Timer is content. Transcription preserves the existing draft; retry follows failure only. Microphone denial is explained by a tooltip/status. Runtime owns capture, timer and transcription.

componentSets.description: Independent task status. Show metrics only when measured; elapsed time and rate are optional content. Stop requests cancellation; Stopped requires actual owner cleanup. Retry is explicit, never automatic replay. Reduced motion keeps readable status.
componentSets.name: Alva RunStatus

componentSets.description: Single-select task permission menu. Selection updates the trigger and closes the menu. Full requires an explicit scope confirmation before becoming effective. This design grants no permission. Hover/focus explanation: {'Ask': '执行需要权限的操作前询问；本次批准只适用于所示范围。', 'Auto': '工作区内写文件与安全命令自动执行；越界写、危险命令和 MCP 工具仍会询问。', 'Full': '允许当前任务在所授范围内执行；沙箱与组织限制仍有效。'}
componentSets.name: Alva PermissionMenu

componentSets.description: One editor popover for +, @ and /. List selection drives the detail preview; samples are not installed capabilities. Runtime filters, scrolls and inserts only on confirmation. Up/Down selects, Enter inserts, Esc closes and returns focus. Constrain to viewport; below 480px stack detail below selection. No global permission is granted by attaching a directory.
componentSets.name: Alva ComposerMenu
